139    /**
140     * PESEL - Universal Electronic System for Registration of the Population
141     *
142     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PESEL
143     *
144     * @param DateTime $birthdate
145     * @param string   $sex       M for male or F for female
146     *
147     * @return string 11 digit number, like 44051401358
148     */
149    public static function pesel($birthdate = null, $sex = null)
150    {
151        if ($birthdate === null) {
152            $birthdate = \Faker\Provider\DateTime::dateTimeThisCentury();
153        }
154
155        $weights = [1, 3, 7, 9, 1, 3, 7, 9, 1, 3];
156        $length = count($weights);
157
158        $fullYear = (int) $birthdate->format('Y');
159        $year = (int) $birthdate->format('y');
160        $month = $birthdate->format('m') + (((int) ($fullYear / 100) - 14) % 5) * 20;
161        $day = $birthdate->format('d');
162
163        $result = [(int) ($year / 10), $year % 10, (int) ($month / 10), $month % 10, (int) ($day / 10), $day % 10];
164
165        for ($i = 6; $i < $length; ++$i) {
166            $result[$i] = static::randomDigit();
167        }
168
169        $result[$length - 1] |= 1;
170
171        if ($sex == 'F') {
172            $result[$length - 1] -= 1;
173        }
174
175        $checksum = 0;
176
177        for ($i = 0; $i < $length; ++$i) {
178            $checksum += $weights[$i] * $result[$i];
179        }
180        $checksum = (10 - ($checksum % 10)) % 10;
181        $result[] = $checksum;
182
183        return implode('', $result);
184    }

186    /**
187     * National Identity Card number
188     *
189     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polish_National_Identity_Card
190     *
191     * @return string 3 letters and 6 digits, like ABA300000
192     */
193    public static function personalIdentityNumber()
194    {
195        $range = str_split('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNPRSTUVWXYZ');
196        $low = ['A', static::randomElement($range), static::randomElement($range)];
197        $high = [static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit()];
198        $weights = [7, 3, 1, 7, 3, 1, 7, 3];
199        $checksum = 0;
200
201        for ($i = 0, $size = count($low); $i < $size; ++$i) {
202            $checksum += $weights[$i] * (ord($low[$i]) - 55);
203        }
204
205        for ($i = 0, $size = count($high); $i < $size; ++$i) {
206            $checksum += $weights[$i + 3] * $high[$i];
207        }
208        $checksum %= 10;
209
210        return implode('', $low) . $checksum . implode('', $high);
211    }

213    /**
214     * Taxpayer Identification Number (NIP in Polish)
215     *
216     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PESEL#Other_identifiers
217     * @see http://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/NIP
218     *
219     * @return string 10 digit number
220     */
221    public static function taxpayerIdentificationNumber()
222    {
223        $weights = [6, 5, 7, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
224        $result = [];
225
226        do {
227            $result = [
228                static::randomDigitNotNull(), static::randomDigitNotNull(), static::randomDigitNotNull(),
229                static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit(),
230                static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit(), static::randomDigit(),
231            ];
232            $checksum = 0;
233
234            for ($i = 0, $size = count($result); $i < $size; ++$i) {
235                $checksum += $weights[$i] * $result[$i];
236            }
237            $checksum %= 11;
238        } while ($checksum == 10);
239        $result[] = $checksum;
240
241        return implode('', $result);
242    }
